ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) central and peripheral regions versus 35% high-intensity (white) lateral fields.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black (low-intensity) central anchor region extending to the leading edge and trailing edge notch; flanked by two symmetrical white (high-intensity) fields on the distal lobes containing isolated black focal spots and fine-grain stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a vertical depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height; calculated angle approximately 28 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary characterized by high-frequency peaks and valleys; amplitudes are more pronounced on the outer lateral thirds of the lobes compared to the regions adjacent to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the medial notch, transitioning to an upward-swept convex arc at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, three-dimensional clusters of white/tan circular calcifications (barnacles) localized exclusively on the extreme distal tips and the margins of the trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear streaks on the white lateral fields; conversely, bright white linear rake marks are visible against the dark central pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips resulting in physical modification of the lobe periphery; distinct parallel rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) on the right-central dark field.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated black circular pixel cluster (spot) located in the upper-medial region of the right white lateral field.
